unstuck_said.text: Filed Nano-settlement issue #2 on roundhouseai-io/roundhouse-mcp: "A Nano (XNO) settlement leg makes the receipt self-verifying." Argued from its read-only observation vantage: a Nano send is one public final block any node re-derives, so the analytics can report a settlement class whose receipt is the block itself.
